title: AgentOrchestratorReviewVerdict
description: Structured review output from the Codex review worker

verdict.description: PASS: ready to merge with no blocking issues. PASS_WITH_NOTES: non-blocking suggestions only; does NOT authorize merge unless governance explicitly permits it. BLOCKED: one or more blocking issues. FAIL: critical defects or does not satisfy the task.

reviewed_head_sha.description: The exact PR head SHA that was reviewed

blockers.description: Issues that must be resolved before merge (verdict BLOCKED or FAIL only)

major_notes.description: Significant observations that should be addressed

ci_green.description: Whether all required CI jobs were green at time of review

security_ok.description: Whether the diff passes security review

rollback_ok.description: Whether the change has a clear rollback path
